Traffic signs communicate rules, hazards, road location, directions and nearby roadway services. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A24
A sign's shape, color, symbols and wording help identify the kind of information it conveys. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A24
Regulatory signs communicate traffic laws or regulations that govern traffic movement. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A24
Observe the posted school-zone speed restriction during the hours specified on its sign. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A25
A red circle crossed by a slash means that the action represented by the sign is forbidden. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A25
Warning signs alert a driver to potential danger farther along the road. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A25
Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow, with black symbols or lettering. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0025]

Confusables: green permits movement only when clear; flashing yellow requires caution, while flashing red requires a complete stop. Mnemonic: clear path before movement. Glossary: right of way means priority; regulatory signs state traffic rules; warning signs identify possible hazards. These descriptions organize the cited statements and do not replace their conditions.
